scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @key/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @key/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @key/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @key/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @key/html2docx && npm run typecheck -w @key/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @key/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @key/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @key/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @key/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @key/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @key/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @key/ui && npm run typecheck -w @key/docs && npm run typecheck -w @key/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @key/slides && npm run typecheck -w @key/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @key/html && npm run typecheck -w @key/electron
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @key/docs && npm run build -w @key/sheets && npm run build -w @key/slides && npm run build -w @key/markdown && npm run build -w @key/html && npm run build -w @key/electron
